content.text:
Pickiness around greens is really common at 28 months, and it usually passes. Try putting one tiny bite of a green next to foods he already likes, with no pressure to eat it. Let him touch it, smell it, or ignore it. It can take a dozen or more calm exposures before a toddler tastes something. Letting him "help" by tearing spinach or rinsing broccoli often makes him braver, too.

Also, I can try signing him up for classes now if you ever want that. I told you in October that I couldn't, and that's no longer true.
